title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
U.S. Department of Justice
       Office of the Solicitor General




       Washington, D.C. 20530

       May 14, 2025

Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543

  Re:  United States Postal Service, et al. v. Lebene Konan, No. 24-351

Dear Mr. Harris:

 The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above -captioned case was granted  on April 21,
2025, and petitioners’ opening brief is currently due on June 5, 2025.

Because of the press of other cases, the parties respectfully request, under this Court’s Rule
30.4, that the time within which to file petitioners’ brief (and the joint appendix) be extended to
and including June 24, 2025, and that the time within which to file respondent’s brief be extended
to and including August 13, 2025.  If those extensions are granted, the reply brief would be due on
September 12, 2025.

 All parties consent to this briefing schedule.


      Sincerely,



      D. John Sauer
      Solicitor General
